package.description: Convert, browse and clear cached images and files.

en-US.description: Convert, browse and clear cached images and files.
en-US.longDescription:
Images you see online are never deleted immediately, unless you delete them of course.
Most desktop apps have a cache directory, not all provide the tools to clear it.
CacheMonkey not only lets you purge cache files, but browse and filter through them too.
en-US.name: CacheMonkey
